//: Repo-wide typecheck, including tests, scripts and examples (chant #1388).
CI typechecks packages/core and packages/k8s-client, and check-lexicons builds each
lexicon's tsconfig.build.json — which excludes **/*.test.ts, correctly, since a
published lexicon should not ship its tests. The consequence was that nothing
typechecked a lexicon test at all: `tsc -p lexicons/forgejo/tsconfig.build.json
--listFiles | grep -c '.test.ts'` returns 0, while packages/core typechecks its 266.
A type-level assertion written in a lexicon test was evaluated by nothing, which is
why #1344's ChantConfig augmentation proofs had to live in compiled source.
moduleResolution is bundler here, as in the root config since chant #3087 (TypeScript 7
drops node10 resolution and baseUrl). Tests and examples run under vitest and tsx, which
both resolve like a bundler. The setting is repeated here so this config states it.
test/ joined the include in chant #1984. The repo-wide gates live there — the
no-consumer-apps ruling, the lexicon-artifacts guard, the no-egress guard — and every
one of them was typechecked by nothing, which is the same gap this config was created
to close for lexicon tests. Three files in the tree still used Bun's import.meta.dir;
they became import.meta.dirname rather than baseline entries.
